Dummy Magazine — April 24, 2013

Premiere: Sinkane - Warm Spell

By Selim Bulut · Dummy Magazine

Sinkane lands on an alien world populated by sirens in this (probably NSFW) video.

The (probably NSFW) video for Sinkane's Warm Spell is apparently about a man who lands in an alternate reality populated by sirens (said alternate reality mainly consists of close-ups of fruit and flowers that directors and photographers Philip Di Fiore and Christopher J. Lytwyn took), who discovers he has to give into his primal desires in order to understand the world around him. Whether you're on board with this idea or not, there's no denying that it's a gorgeous video that, despite being shot in black and white, feels very colourful. The song is a belter too, starting off as a free jazz exploration before giving way to a tribal funk groove. It's taken from Sinkane's debut album 'Mars', released last year via City Slang (DFA put it out in the US, which in itself is a seal of approval, if one were needed).

Originally published by Dummy Magazine, April 24, 2013. Archived via the Wayback Machine.
